name: step
source: optimizer steps completed before this one

name: stage
source: data_stages entry active at this step

name: loss
source: total = loss_ntp + z_loss, mean over the global batch

name: loss_ntp
source: next-token cross-entropy, mean over the global batch (losses.tsv)

name: loss_mtp
source: reserved, MTP off in v0 (head.mtp_heads 0): always null

name: z_loss
source: z_loss_coef * mean(logsumexp(logits)^2)

name: grad_norm
source: global grad norm before clipping (all shards and stages)

name: lr
source: WSD schedule optim.lr_at, applied to all param groups

name: tokens_per_second
source: global_batch_seqs*seq_len / step wall time

name: step_time_ms
source: wall time of the step on rank 0 (incl. comm, excl. eval/checkpoint)

name: gpu_alloc_gb
source: peak allocated during the step: torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated()/1e9 on rank 0 (peak stats reset each step); 0 on CPU

name: spike_score
source: (loss - mean)/std over the last safety.spike_window losses; null < 10 losses

name: ema_z
source: (loss - EMA)/sqrt(EMA var), alpha safety.ema_alpha; null before step 10

name: update_to_weight_ratio
source: ||w_after - w_before|| / ||w_before||, all params

name: max_attn_logit
source: max |q.k|/sqrt(hd) over layers, last micro-batch

name: held_out_loss
source: mean CE over data.val_batch() windows (equal windows per source) after the step

name: held_out_loss_<source>
source: same, one key per dataset name (e.g. held_out_loss_hin)

name: bpb
source: sum of window CE nats / ln2 / UTF-8 bytes of the evaluated target tokens (tokenizer byte lengths; EOS = 0), so it weights sources like the CE

name: dead_experts
source: experts with 0 routed tokens this step, summed over MoE layers

name: top_expert_share
source: max over MoE layers of the busiest expert's token share

name: moe_aux
source: seq-wise aux loss (coef applied), last micro-batch, summed over layers; in the gradient, not in `loss`

name: moe_layers
source: one object per MoE layer: layer, load (fractions of routed slots per expert), dead_experts, top_expert_share, max_vio (max_load/mean_load - 1), router_entropy (nats, of scores/sum), intervention_rate (share of top-k picks where the bias changed the choice vs topk of the raw scores), topk_mass (mean share of the score sum on the selected experts), aux. Load/MaxVio are global (dp all-reduced); entropy/intervention/mass are token means over this step's training forwards, dp-reduced
